title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-wa51: test/vectors/edhoc.json stale after TH computation fix
description: The EDHOC TH computation fix in python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py changed TH_3 and TH_4 to use plaintext instead of ciphertext (per RFC 9528 Section 3.5), but test/vectors/edhoc.json was not regenerated. The stored TH_3, TH_4, and responder TH values are now stale and will cause test_edhoc_vectors_match_generator to fail. Regenerate with: PYTHONPATH=python/src python3 test/vectors/generate.py
